name: lazyfinder-rows-git-comfortable
criterio: cerebro S5 (order 07, revision 2): the row height comes from the density setting, not from git; with the default density (comfortable) rows are two lines apart on purpose, git or not
cmd: cd "${TUIQA_HOME}/proj" && git init -q -b trunk . && git add . && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -m init && echo changed >> notes.txt && echo x > loose.txt && printf '{"version":1,"density":"comfortable"}' > "${TUIQA_HOME}/cfg.json" && LAZYFINDER_CONFIG="${TUIQA_HOME}/cfg.json" exec "${LAZYFINDER_BIN}" .

steps.desc: with the default density (comfortable) rows are two lines apart on purpose, git or not
